verdict.rationale: Drata's own docs say it connects tools to automate evidence collection and monitors controls and evidence. Its open-source agent reads endpoint security settings (screensaver lock, antivirus, auto-updates), which is machine-gathered evidence. However, the pack only shows that automated collection exists: it does not document how often collection runs or whether artifacts are timestamped and versioned. missing for 10: documented recurring collection schedule/frequency, evidence that artifacts are timestamped, explicit replacement of screenshots/CSV exports, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, evidence is collected automatically from connected systems on a schedule — screenshots and CSV exports are replaced by timestamped, machine-gathered artifacts

citations.quote: Connect on-premise tools and custom workflows to automate evidence collection.
Monitor controls, evidence, and personnel to streamline operations.

This application is granted READ ONLY access to your system preferences to help ensure proper security configurations are set - such as screensaver locking, password manager, antivirus software and automatic updates are enabled.
